item.title: C, ELF and Zig
item.description:
There are something we should always remember. They are basics and foundations of computing system. You have to master them to write and understand C program very well.

What is the difference between deleting a segment of code and killing a person…?

C Programming Language

  • C is more than 50 years old, which is still very popular and good.
  • C or Non-C. ?
  • C is high-level and portable assembly language. Assembly languange is not portalbe. It has to be associated with ISA (Instruction Set Architecture). C is just a thin portable layer above assembly.
  • Modern C: ANSI-C/C89/C90 –> C99 –> C11 –> C17 –> C23
  • C is a strictly typing and compiling language. You mindset is about CPU, memory, bits and bytes while programming in C.

Compilation

  • Each .c file is compiled separately. We can get .o files from .c files. Then all .o files are linked together and produce executable binary file. Therefore we have make -j<N>.
  • Before compilation, there is a pre-processing step in which all pre-processing macros are executed or replaced. The pre-processing results are normally stored in .i files, which are normally invisible temperory files. gcc -E command gives us .i files.
  • We can also ask for generate assembly files .s by gcc -S command from .c files. Compile .s file can also give us .o file.
  • .o files are in ELF format. We can get .o files from .c, .s or objcopy.

.c –> [.i –> .s – >] .o –> ELF
